mapper.select: SELECT ar.id, ar.audit_no AS auditNo, ar.audit_type AS auditType, ar.business_id AS businessId, ar.title, ar.content, ar.attachments, ar.current_status AS currentStatus, ar.priority, ar.submit_time AS submitTime, ar.finish_time AS finishTime, ar.final_opinion AS finalOpinion, ar.reject_reason AS rejectReason, ar.current_admin_id AS currentAdminId, ar.applicant_id AS applicantId, ar.create_time AS createTime, ar.update_time AS updateTime, u.username AS applicantUsername, u.name AS applicantName, u.avatar AS applicantAvatar, u.phone AS applicantPhone, a.name AS currentAdminName FROM audit_record ar LEFT JOIN user_info u ON ar.applicant_id = u.id LEFT JOIN admin_info a ON ar.current_admin_id = a.id WHERE ar.id = #{id} AND ar.is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(1) > 0 FROM audit_record WHERE id = #{id} AND audit_type IN (4, 5) AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT current_status FROM audit_record WHERE id = #{id} AND audit_type IN (4, 5) AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE audit_record SET current_status = 2, current_admin_id = #{adminId}, final_opinion = #{opinion}, finish_time = #{finishTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND audit_type IN (4, 5) AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE audit_record SET current_status = 3, current_admin_id = #{adminId}, final_opinion = #{opinion}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, finish_time = #{finishTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND audit_type IN (4, 5) AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN audit_type = 5 AND current_status IN (0, 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingPostReportCount, SUM(CASE WHEN audit_type = 4 AND current_status IN (0, 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingReplyReportCount, SUM(CASE WHEN current_status IN (2, 3) AND finish_time >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS monthProcessedReportCount FROM audit_record WHERE audit_type IN (4, 5) AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT ar.business_id AS businessId, ar.audit_type AS auditType, ar.applicant_id AS applicantId, CASE WHEN ar.audit_type = 5 THEN (SELECT user_id FROM forum_post WHERE id = ar.business_id) WHEN ar.audit_type = 4 THEN (SELECT user_id FROM post_reply WHERE id = ar.business_id) END AS reportedUserId FROM audit_record ar WHERE ar.id = #{id} AND ar.is_deleted = 0
